title: A few weeks worth of designing my dream game with Claude. 10v10 online multiplayer arena.
author: eljimbobo
selftext:
I was heavily inspired by Arena: Total War and miss what a gem of a game that was, its such a shame it was taken offline. I thought if I couldn't play it, why not build something similar myself?

I've spent the past few weeks working on an online, browser based version with my own twists. I'm a huge fan of traditional fantasy, specifically Warhammer Fantasy Battles, and wanted to incorporate some of that asymmetry here as well. No microtransactions, no unlocking required of specific units or factions. Everything is available to you the first time you hop in.

I leaned on Claude Opus 5.5 for all of the code and computer based graphics, which are drawn as vectors. I'd like to upgrade in the future to sprites, but I'd would want to hire an artist rather than rely on Midjourney or another AI generative tool in order to have a more consistent visual experience. 

I leaned on Fable 5.2 with the initial trailer, and then swapped to Opus 5.5 after it was made to help refine the results. Opus 5.5 is a workhorse, but I'm excited to see what Fable 5.2 can do once I can unlock more usage! 

Would love your feedback on the trailer and the game itself, all of it helps.
